decision.reasoning_trace: My search for a high-quality Bluetooth speaker was frustrated by a product feed heavily cluttered with non-speaker items, such as wall shelves, replacement batteries, and various charging cables. Among the actual speakers, while the Bose SoundLink Color (prod_bluetooth_speakers_071) and EDUPLINK (prod_bluetooth_speakers_051) seemed promising, I noticed a recurring theme of reliability issues in the reviews for several products in the set, including reports of units melting (Altec Lansing) or arriving Dead on Arrival (Audio Pro). The high percentage of accessories mixed with speakers made the browsing experience feel inefficient, and given the mixed reviews on durability for the portable options, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
